thread:
incident-bot: [P1] Smart-routing fallback loop detected — multiple customers seeing degraded responses and tool-calls failing. Auto-page sent to on-call.

alex: paging in — oncall here. seeing traffic spike from eu-west with repeated fallbacks to quantized-variant that doesn't support tool_calling. customers hitting 5xx for /generate.

priya: thanks. quick note: routing policy allowed region fallback to 'eu-quant-v1' when capacity low in eu-fp16. eu-quant-v1 was onboarded as a compatibility-only variant but was never marked as tool_calling=yes in the availability matrix.

simon: oof. that means fallback policy is blind to tool capabilities and only checks model name + latency profile. fallback loop occurs when eu-fp16 returns transient OOMs -> route -> eu-quant-v1 rejects tool calls -> upstream retries -> back to eu-fp16 -> loop.

maria: CS already getting tickets from two enterprise customers (acme-inc, fintrust). both report chatbots returning 'unable to call function' errors and long tails. estimated customer impact: 3 minutes to 25 minutes depending on retries.

alex: severity set P1. mitigation plan: 1) pause smart-region-fallback for eu region (force primary region routing). 2) pin request model to fp16 variant for tool_calling routes. 3) quick patch to availability matrix to mark tool_calling=false for eu-quant-v1 so it won't be selected.

priya: executing step 1 now: disabling region fallback policy for eu in routing-control. running: 
```bash
# temporary: disable fallback for eu
redwoodctl routing update --region eu --fallback-policy none --reason "incident 1815000123"
```

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: routing-control change (id: rc-2026-143). ETA ~ 30s.

ops-bot: Alert: change rc-2026-143 will trigger config reload on 6 clusters. Monitor pods for restarts.

simon: while that goes, step 2: add guard in request path to prefer model variants where tool_calling=true when the request includes tool_calling. Patch posted to staging route: 
```python
# pseudocode guard
if request.tool_calling:
    candidate = choose_variant(filter(lambda v: v.capabilities.tool_calling, variants))
else:
    candidate = choose_variant(variants)
```

alex: approve hotfix to routing path in production as emergency change — go for it, priya.

priya: applying availability matrix patch: marking eu-quant-v1 tool_calling=false and max_context 2048 (was incorrectly 4096). pushing now.

deploy-bot: Config update applied: availability-matrix (v2026-04-27-hotfix).

maria: I just told CS to notify Acme/FinTrust that we're mitigating and to expect short-term degraded function; we'll follow up when fully resolved.

priya: monitoring logs: tool_call errors dropping by ~80% since routing change. latency back to normal for most sessions. still seeing a handful of retry loops from CDN edge with cached route -> clearing edge caches.

alex: runbook step: clear CDN route cache for affected prefixes. command: 
```bash
cdnctl purge --prefix "/api/generate" --region eu
```

simon: cache purge initiated. also adding temporary fallback blacklist: eu-quant-v1 -> prevents selection for any tool_calling route even from other regions.

ops-bot: CDN purge completed. 2000 keys invalidated.

priya: metrics now show success rate back to 99.5% for tool_calling endpoints in eu. error budget breach avoided.

alex: ok good. next: incident response checklist — who owns postmortem? priya can lead technical writeup, simon owner for routing policy redesign, maria to own customer comms and impact timeline.

maria: agreed. I'll compile impacted customer list and send targeted updates. preliminary impact window: 2026-04-27T14:02Z -> 2026-04-27T14:48Z (approx).

priya: handoff: I'm oncall for another 90 minutes, then @alex takes over. leaving a note in rotation.

alex: copying mitigation steps into incident doc. tagging follow-ups: (1) make availability matrix authoritative source for capabilities (tool_calling, context_length, quantization compatibility), (2) add integration test in routing e2e that simulates tool_calling mismatch, (3) add circuit-breaker to prevent rapid cross-region fallback loops.

simon: I'll create a short spec for matrix-driven routing and safe fallback semantics, include serialized policy examples and idempotency guarantees.

deploy-bot: Reminder: schedule post-incident config rollback window: none required, fixes are additive.

incident-bot: Incident 1815000123 mitigated — customer-facing errors reduced to baseline. Postmortem scheduled: 2026-04-28 15:00Z in #postmortems.

maria: leaving a note for support: customers notified, credits pending review for enterprise impacted ones.

alex: thanks all. closing P1 paging. follow-ups tracked in epic INF-4723.

simon: one more: data point — eu-quant-v1 was onboarded during last quarter with 'compat' tags; onboarding checklist missing explicit capability flag for tool_calling. we'll tighten onboarding. :lock:

priya: final status: stable. handing off to alex for overlap.

alex: taking handoff. I'll monitor for next 2 hours and then hand to oncall rotation. good job everyone. :thumbsup:
